PM Aesthetics was founded by primary care-trained providers who understand the importance of coordinated, ethical medical care. We're not a retail medspa, we're a clinician-led medical practice that treats aesthetic medicine with the same rigor and accountability you'd expect from any medical specialty. Why Refer Your Patients to PM Aesthetics? What This Means for Your Patients: Safe, ethical care from medically licensed providers (NPs, PAs, MDs) No pressure sales tactics - We never use commissions or quotas that incentivize over-treatment Transparent communication - We'll update you on treatments and coordinate care when appropriate Medical-grade standards - FDA-approved products only, strict sterility protocols, emergency preparedness Realistic expectations - We refuse inappropriate treatments and have candid conversations about achievable outcomes We protect your patients the same way you do: by putting medicine before marketing. Comprehensive Aesthetic Services INJECTABLES Botox & Xeomin (neuromodulators) Dermal fillers (Juvéderm and Radiesse) Customized treatment plans based on facial anatomy Conservative dosing protocols SKIN REJUVENATION Chemical peels (VI Peel, ZO Peels) RF Microneedling (Morpheus8, Cutera Secret RF, Lutronic Genius) Advanced facials (Salt Facial, DiamondGlow facials) Medical-grade skincare (ZO Skin Health, Alastin, Neocutis, SkinMedica) LASER & LIGHT THERAPY IPL photofacial (pigmentation, redness, rosacea) Laser hair removal (Cutera Excel HR) Laser Genesis (anti-aging, texture improvement) Skin tightening (Ultherapy, TriLift) BODY CONTOURING Non-surgical fat reduction (Venus Bliss) Skin tightening treatments Cellulite reduction protocols MEDICAL WEIGHT LOSS GLP-1 therapy (semaglutide, tirzepatide) Physician-supervised protocols Comprehensive metabolic assessment One-on-one coaching and support All treatments performed by licensed medical providers with advanced training in aesthetic medicine. The PM Aesthetics Difference 1. Medical Oversight & Safety All providers are medically licensed (NP, PA, MD) On-site medical supervision and emergency protocols Documented adverse event reporting and escalation procedures Compliance with FDA guidelines and manufacturer protocols Emergency equipment and trained response teams ​ We're prepared for complications, and we train to prevent them. 2. No Commission-Based Care All staff and management are salaried, never compensated based on sales Treatment recommendations based solely on clinical appropriateness Authority to refuse treatment when not in patient's best interest No sales quotas, no upselling pressure Your patients receive the treatment they need, not the treatment that maximizes our revenue. 3. Evidence-Based Practice Quarterly advanced training with industry leaders Only FDA-approved, pharmaceutical-grade products No experimental or off-label treatments without informed consent Published safety protocols and clinical guidelines Conservative approach to dosing and treatment frequency We follow the science, not social media trends. 4. Transparent Pricing No hidden fees or surprise charges No bait-and-switch tactics or pressure sales Clear, upfront pricing for all services Membership options for patients seeking regular care Your patients know exactly what they're paying before treatment begins. 5. Patient Education Comprehensive consultation process (45-60 minutes minimum) Realistic outcome expectations set before treatment Detailed informed consent procedures Accessible provider communication (not shuffled to front desk) We educate first, then treat. 6. Locally Owned & Independent No private equity or venture capital backing Long-term relationships, not quarterly targets Community-focused care Your patients' data stays private and protected ​ We're accountable to our patients and referring providers, not investors. Clinical Expertise You Can Trust Our Providers: Primary care-trained medical professionals Advanced certification in aesthetic medicine Extensive training in facial anatomy and injection techniques Ongoing education in safety protocols and complication management Dr. Cecilia Keady, Medical Director (20+ years of experience) Our Standards: Sterile technique and infection control protocols Emergency preparedness (vasovagal response, vascular occlusion, allergic reactions) Conservative approach to dosing and frequency Multidisciplinary collaboration when indicated Our Commitment: We coordinate care with referring providers when appropriate We document all treatments in HIPAA-compliant EHR We're available for consultation on aesthetic concerns We refer patients back to you for medical concerns outside our scope Your patients deserve providers who understand that aesthetic medicine IS medicine, not marketing. What Your Patients Can Expect During Consultation: Comprehensive assessment of anatomy and goals Discussion of realistic outcomes and limitations Review of risks, benefits, and alternatives No pressure to proceed, education first, always During Treatment: Licensed provider performs all injections (never delegated to unlicensed staff) Conservative approach to dosing Real-time assessment and adjustments Comfort measures (topical numbing, ice, distraction techniques) After Treatment: Clear aftercare instructions (verbal + written) 24/7 access for urgent concerns Complimentary follow-up appointments for assessment Touch-ups when clinically indicated (not just requested) Patient Satisfaction: 5 star average rating 87% consultation-to-treatment conversion rate High return rate for maintenance treatments Strong word-of-mouth referrals Why patients trust us: We tell them what they need to hear, not just what they want to hear. How to Refer Your Patients Option 1: Direct Referral ​Give your patient our contact information and mention PM Aesthetics as a trusted provider for aesthetic concerns. Option 2: Warm Handoff Call us at (603) 341-7100 to discuss the patient's needs and we'll coordinate scheduling. (please inform the receptionist that you are a medical provider looking to provide a referral) We'll keep you informed of your patient's care journey (with their permission) and coordinate when appropriate. Common Referral Scenarios When to Refer: ✓ Patient requesting cosmetic Botox/fillers ✓ Concerns about facial aging, volume loss, skin laxity ✓ Sun damage, pigmentation, rosacea not responding to medical management ✓ Body contouring for patients at or near goal weight ✓ Medical weight loss candidates (BMI >27 with comorbidities or >30) ✓ Patients seeking non-surgical aesthetic options What We Don't Treat (and Refer Back to You): ✗ Medical dermatology (psoriasis, eczema, suspicious lesions) ✗ Skin cancer screening and diagnosis ✗ Eating disorders or body dysmorphia (we screen and refer to mental health) ✗ Any condition requiring medical management outside aesthetic scope We know our lane, and we stay in it. Coordination of Care We'll Communicate With You When: Patient has adverse reaction or complication requiring medical intervention Treatment plan involves significant medication interactions Patient expresses body dysmorphia concerns or unrealistic expectations Patient requests treatment we deem inappropriate (we decline and explain why) Patient has medical conditions that warrant coordination (anticoagulation, autoimmune disease, etc.) How We Communicate: Secure email: support@pmaesthetics.com Phone consultation: (603) 341-7100 We respect your time, communication is concise, relevant, and actionable.
